name: Drupal Metrics
description: Provides database metrics in the Reports section.
project_description: Drupal Metrics adds a read-only report under Administration > Reports > Metrics that surfaces the physical and structural size of a site. Its Database tab lists every table in the site's schema with its on-disk size (data + index length, formatted as a human-readable byte size) and shows the total database footprint, helping administrators spot large tables worth optimizing. Its Entities tab lists every content entity type with its bundle count, and drilling into an entity type shows each bundle's base-field and additional-field counts, then a per-bundle field report with entity counts, translation counts, field names, labels, types and cardinality. The module has no settings form and no dependencies beyond Drupal core; it exposes a single 'view metrics' permission and hangs its pages off the core Reports menu with Database/Entities local-task tabs.
